alyeska-ak: Tram straight up from the resort. Heli and cat options to explore huge terrain with guides.
mt-baker-wa: RVs in the lot, nowhere to stay on the mountain. Side-country focus.
timberline-or: Competitive camps lap it all summer. Isolated, small village, nearly all above treeline.
whistler-blackcomb-bc: Big enough that you need some orientation to make good use of your time.
jackson-hole-wy: Impressive, and hard to get to.
Great terrain mix. Tries really hard to be cowboy, but realistically it's quite bougie.
park-city-ut: Vail Resorts' Utah heartbeat. Massive crowds, and so many other options nearby.
snowbird-ut: Massive terrain, epic steep open bowls, strong lifts. Can be quite crowded.
solitude-ut: Odd lift layout. You can't lap the best terrain efficiently.
alta-ut: Steep. If you're willing to hike, the steeps are awesome.
vail-co: Massive, nothing too steep. Quintessential CO family trip, Bavarian copycat village and all.
